words.example: Every Monday morning we measure how long people wait at registration.
words.exampleZh: 每周一上午，我们衡量人们在挂号处等候多久。

words.example: After the visit, the review group will evaluate the two suppliers.
words.exampleZh: 走访结束后，评审小组会评估这两家供应商。

words.example: Before the probation meeting, HR will assess whether she is ready.
words.exampleZh: 试用考核会之前，人力资源会评定她是否已经胜任。

words.example: This week, can you train the new clerks to call the queue?
words.exampleZh: 这周你能培训新文员叫号吗？

words.example: Coach him through one shift before you leave him on the counter alone.
words.exampleZh: 先辅导他完成一个班次，再让他独自看柜台。

words.example: The generator took the data hall load eight seconds after utility power failed.
words.exampleZh: 市电中断八秒后，发电机接上了机房负载。

words.example: Cooling in row C fell behind, and inlet temperatures passed the alarm line.
words.exampleZh: C 列的机房制冷跟不上，进风温度过了告警线。

words.meaning: 机房空调（Computer Room Air Conditioner）
words.example: CRAC (Computer Room Air Conditioner) two is offline, so row B is running warm.
words.exampleZh: 二号 CRAC（机房空调）停了，B 列现在偏热。

words.example: Lift the raised floor tile carefully; the fiber tray sits just underneath.
words.exampleZh: 掀架空地板的地板砖时慢一点，光纤桥架就在正下面。

words.example: Leave the bottom of this rack empty so the new storage array fits.
words.exampleZh: 这个机柜底部先空着，新存储阵列才放得下。
